summary: Review ERP roles, SoD conflicts and ITGC evidence with practical exercises. Explore the five-day intermediate course and its applied curriculum.
lede: ERP access control uses role-based permissions to match system privileges to job responsibilities in cloud environments. This course is for IT, security, and compliance professionals who safeguard enterprise resource planning systems. It develops skills in designing role models, identifying segregation-of-duties conflicts, and automating user provisioning and de-provisioning workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who administer ERP permissions, review business access or provide assurance over IT general controls. It suits an intermediate level and connects day-to-day authorization work with audit evidence and control decisions.
modules: ERP Access Evidence and Audit Testing
ERP ITGC Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: Working familiarity with ERP users, roles or business transactions is recommended. Basic knowledge of IT controls or audit evidence will help you apply the exercises. No programming is required.
